summary: Iter18 — Client Profile settings (self-service). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (prefill via /portal/me, PUT /portal/profile persists phone/email/address, blank-name blocked (name preserved), endpoint requires auth with no id param, logo upload persists, admin sees updated client + audit row with actor_role=client). Frontend Playwright: nav 'Company Profile' opens /client-portal/profile; prefill loads current values; edit + save shows 'Profile updated' toast and persists across reload; logo upload preview appears and persists after reload; clearing name shows 'Company name is required' toast; admin dispatch/clients + dispatch/audit both reflect the client-triggered update.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: server accepts a whitespace-only name for the 'name' key but silently drops it (returns 400 only if it was the only key). UI-side blocks blank name via toast, which is fine.
Minor: /portal/me returns logo_url only when logo_path is set; if you rely on logo_url downstream after clearing, ensure it is nulled explicitly.
seed_data_creation: None (edits Arseas client in place; test data prefixed UI_TEST/TEST_ADDR).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client profile page lives at /client-portal/profile. Data-testids in place: client-profile-page, profile-name, profile-phone, profile-email, profile-address, profile-logo-upload, profile-logo-input, profile-logo-img, profile-save. Backend audit rows use key 'entity_type' (not 'entity'); include this alias when asserting audit content.
